faq.free: Is Craftisle Draw free to use?
faq.freeAnswer: Yes, Craftisle Draw is completely free to use. No signup required for testing.
faq.collaborate: Can I collaborate with others in real-time?
faq.collaborateAnswer: Yes, you can share your board with others and collaborate in real-time.
faq.exportAnswer: Yes, you can export your drawings as PNG or SVG files.
faq.account: Do I need to create an account?
faq.accountAnswer: No, you can test the tool without creating an account. However, creating an account allows you to save and manage your boards.
faq.secureAnswer: Yes, your data is stored securely. You can also make your boards private or public.

useCases.teachingDesc: Use Craftisle Draw as a free online whiteboard for teaching. Create interactive lessons, explain concepts with hand-drawn diagrams, and share whiteboards with students.
useCases.remoteTeamsDesc: Real-time collaborative whiteboard for remote teams. Brainstorm, plan sprints, and collaborate visually with your team.
useCases.brainstormingDesc: Free brainstorming tool online. Generate ideas with your team on an infinite canvas. Use sticky notes, draw connections, and export your brainstorming session.
useCases.flowchartDesc: Create flowcharts online for free. Use our flowchart maker to visualize processes, workflows, and algorithms.
useCases.mindMapDesc: Free mind map tool online. Organize your thoughts, plan projects, and visualize concepts with mind maps.
useCases.agileDesc: Whiteboard for agile teams. Run retrospectives, sprint planning, and stand-ups on a free online whiteboard.
useCases.designThinkingDesc: Design thinking whiteboard for innovation. Use our free online whiteboard to run design thinking workshops.
useCases.meetingsDesc: Meeting presentation whiteboard. Create visual presentations, annotate in real-time, and share with stakeholders.
